attributes.title: CAPNI Annual Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Noblesville Indianapolis Conference Center
attributes.organizer: Coalition of Advanced Practice Registered Nurses of Indiana
attributes.summary:
Indiana APRNs meet in Noblesville on February 24 and 25, 2027, with a welcome reception the evening before. CAPNI is still filling in the agenda, and sessions include breakfast product theaters, so note which hours are CE and which are industry programs.

The page promises CE, but the number of contact hours is not published yet. The early-bird cutoff date is not stated, so confirm it when you register.
